children.title: Inventory exact section/row/cell ownership and lifecycle

children.title: Build context and version matrix independently of syntax

children.title: Prioritize dependencies using real-document impact without closing semantic gaps

children.title: Expression precedence, universal/local literals and typed units

children.title: Escaped named-row references through rename/delete

children.title: Resolve every sheet-owner context through one host contract

children.expected_behavior: Resolve intended owner and dependencies consistently across scalar, field, geometry and control consumers.

children.title: Coercion, error values and invalid-input preservation
children.input: Invalid types/units, error propagation, cycles, missing references and bounded resource inputs.
children.expected_behavior: Reference-confirmed error/coercion behavior is represented explicitly; unsupported semantics retain source and expose stale caches.

children.title: GUARD and SETATREF transactional redirection
children.input: Guarded multi-hop redirects, lazy branches, constrained drags and cell edits followed by cancel/undo/save.
children.expected_behavior: Writes use intended target/cell scope; cancel restores all semantic state and guarded formulas remain protected.

children.title: Typed inherited/local value resolution
